svg.title: LOAD · narrow edge first / no trimming
svg.desc: 5 Slide a whole uncut Instax Mini sheet into the already assembled frame, narrow border first. Enter from the left for a landscape frame, with the wide caption border trailing on the left. Enter from the bottom for a portrait frame, with the wide caption border trailing below. Do not cut the instant film. 6 Place the frame on the fridge, magnet side toward the fridge.
